columns.description: Cedar-minted surrogate primary key, `CEDAR-ENT-nnnnnn`, allocated by `cedar_ids.allocate()` under the registry file lock. It is deliberately NOT a mnemonic slug: a slug built from a firm's name - and a sole proprietorship's legal name is frequently a private person's name - would mint the disclosure into the primary key of every downstream join. `cedar_ids.is_internal()` returns True for it, so it is never presented as an official identifier. Also the spine `tribe_id`.
columns.name: surrogate_entity_id

columns.description: Always `Individually Native-owned business`. A firm owned by one private individual or a family, not by a nation, a corporation with shareholders by birthright, or a community. NEVER summed with any tribal, ANC or NHO total. These firms were never in one, and no published tribal figure changes because this class exists.
columns.name: entity_class

columns.description: WITHHELD from publication. The firm's legal or modal awardee name. Cedar Press's standing policy is inherited, not restated: `nrc_meeting_participants` - "Cedar Press names an individual only where a public professional capacity is established"; `ferc_ex_parte_parties` - "Cedar Press does not publish datasets about private individuals." Released only where publish_name = 1.
examples: Cherokee Joint Venture Limited Liability Company
columns.name: canonical_name

columns.description: `UEI`, `CAGE`, or `NAME`. A `NAME` ruling binds NOTHING in the identifier ledger - a name is not an identifier - so those firms carry an entity and no contract rows rather than a guessed join.
columns.name: identifier_type

columns.description: WITHHELD from publication. SAM's public entity search resolves a UEI to a legal name and a street address, so where the legal name is a private person's name this identifier publishes the name by ONE HOP. Released only where firm_legal_name_is_person = 0, or on recorded consent. Independent of the D&B question and survives any answer to it.
columns.name: identifier

columns.description: WITHHELD from publication. for a single-firm row. State publishes only inside an aggregate of at least 3 firms; a state plus a sector plus a year on one privately owned firm is a name written in another alphabet.
columns.name: state

columns.description: `INDIVIDUAL_NATIVE` or `INDIVIDUAL_NATIVE_NOT_TRIBAL`. Read literally as "not Native" it inverts the owner's meaning; the class value exists to keep the DIRECTION of the refusal visible.

primary_key.evidence: SAM's public entity search resolves a UEI to a legal name and a street address. For a firm whose legal name IS a person's name, publishing the UEI publishes the person by one hop. cedar_domain already withholds awardee_uei and cage_code for exactly this reason; the primary key must obey the same rule or it reintroduces what the field policy removed.
